title: Agent-Conditioned Routing: Diverse Reasoning Paths Within One Frozen Model
title_zh: 智能体条件化路由：单一冻结模型内的多样化推理路径

paragraphs.en: Generating several solutions can expose alternative methods, but additional trajectories often paraphrase one dominant approach. We investigate whether the conditional capacity of a frozen sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) model can provide such diversity from one problem prompt, without user-assigned roles, prescribed methods, fine-tuning, or model copies. Agent-Conditioned Routing ( ACR ) assigns m m parallel trajectories persistent, untrained shared/private expert-eligibility masks while preserving the learned, input-dependent token router. On a screened 126-question multi-mode mathematics and physics benchmark, with model judges reading the reported derivations in full, we count the number of problems yielding at least two distinct primary methods among soft-correct solutions in four trajectories. ACR reaches approximately twice as many such problems as the strongest temperature setting under GLM 5.3 (37.3 versus 18.7), and 1.67 times as many under GPT-5.6 Sol (45.00 versus 27.00), at matched output budgets. A blinded four-expert audit on a stratified sample of 30 problems also finds more multi-method solutions with ACR on both backbones, with lower correctness. Matched-eligibility ablations show modest multi-method count advantages for ACR , while token-resampled masks attain higher correctness. An informed sequential prompt elicits more diversity still, using previous solutions and explicit requests for alternative methods. ACR adds about 160 KiB of mask state. In a three-problem microbenchmark capped at 1,024 tokens, its latency and peak VRAM usage remain within 3% of batched temperature sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 生成多个解法可以暴露出不同的方法，但额外的轨迹往往只是对同一种主导方法的改写。 我们研究一个冻结的稀疏专家混合（MoE）模型的条件化能力，能否在用户不指定角色、不规定方法、无需微调或复制模型的情况下，仅凭一个问题提示就提供这种多样性。 智能体条件化路由（ACR）为 m m 条并行轨迹分配持久的、未经训练的共享/私有专家资格掩码，同时保留模型学习到的、依赖于输入的词元路由器。 在一个经过筛选的126题多模式数学与物理基准上，由模型裁判完整阅读所报告的推导过程，我们统计在四条轨迹的软正确解法中，至少出现两种不同主要方法的问题数量。 在相同的输出预算下，ACR 在 GLM 5.3 上达到的此类问题数量约为最强温度设置的两倍（37.3 对 18.7），在 GPT-5.6 Sol 上为 1.67 倍（45.00 对 27.00）。 在30个问题的分层样本上进行的盲测四专家审计也发现，在两个骨干模型上 ACR 都产生更多多方法解法，但正确率更低。 匹配资格的消融实验显示，ACR 在多方法计数上具有适度的优势，而重新采样词元的掩码则达到更高的正确率。 使用先前解法并明确提出替代方法请求的知情的顺序提示，仍能引出更多多样性。 ACR 仅增加约 160 KiB 的掩码状态。 在一个上限为 1,024 词元的三问题微型基准中，其延迟和峰值显存（VRAM）占用与批量温度采样相差不超过 3%。

paragraphs.en: Inference-time scaling treats additional generations as additional chances of success, but samples that repeat one argument inherit the same blind spots. Answer-level techniques such as self-consistency still benefit from repeated samples on verifiable tasks ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , yet agreement does not reveal whether derivations differ meaningfully. For mathematical and scientific reasoning, we therefore study correct method diversity : on how many problems do four trajectories yield at least two distinct primary solution methods with correct conclusions under a fixed generation budget?
paragraphs.zh: 推理时扩展将额外的生成视为额外的成功机会，但重复同一论证的样本会继承相同的盲点。 在可验证任务上，诸如自洽性等答案层面的技术仍然能从重复样本中受益（Wang et al., 2023），然而一致性并不能揭示各推导过程是否有实质差异。 因此，对于数学与科学推理，我们研究正确方法多样性：在固定的生成预算下，有多少问题的四条轨迹能产生至少两种截然不同的、且结论正确的主要求解方法？

paragraphs.en: One can seek diversity through decoding, method prompts, trained adapters, or coordinated models. We target autonomous method diversification : the user supplies a problem without having to identify alternative solution techniques in advance. We constrain expert eligibility in a frozen sparse MoE while retaining its learned token router. MoEs expose alternative feed-forward paths through conditional computation ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Lepikhin et al., 2021 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Du et al., 2022 ) . The question is whether these constraints change the executed derivation while preserving correctness, not merely whether they change the text.
paragraphs.zh: 人们可以通过解码、方法提示、训练适配器或协调多个模型来寻求多样性。 我们的目标是自主的方法多样化：用户只需提供一个问题，而无需事先识别出其他替代的解决方案技术。 我们在一个冻结的稀疏 MoE 中限制专家的可用范围，同时保留其已学习到的词元路由器。 MoE 通过条件计算提供了替代的前向传播路径（Shazeer 等，2017；Lepikhin 等，2021；Fedus 等，2022；Du 等，2022）。 问题的关键在于这些约束能否在保持正确性的同时改变实际执行的推导过程，而不仅仅是它们是否改变了文本。

paragraphs.en: Agent-Conditioned Routing ( ACR ) executes m = 4 m{=}4 route-conditioned trajectories on one frozen Qwen3.6-35B-A3B instance in one batched request. Here agent denotes a route-conditioned trajectory. All trajectories receive the same prompt and use deterministic decoding, with no role prompts, role generation, updates, communication, or model copies. A seeded construction assigns each a persistent shared/private eligibility mask; the frozen learned router still selects its top- k k experts within that eligible set.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体条件路由（ACR）在单个冻结的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 实例上、于一次批量请求中执行 m{=}4 条路由条件化的轨迹。 此处的「智能体」指一条路由条件化的轨迹。 所有轨迹接收相同的提示词并使用确定性解码，没有任何角色提示、角色生成、更新、通信或模型副本。 通过带种子的构造为每条轨迹分配一个持久的共享/私有专家资格掩码；冻结的已学习路由器仍在该资格集合内选择其 top-k 专家。

paragraphs.en: Agent-Conditioned Routing. We introduce a training-free inference mechanism that uses expert eligibility as a control for reasoning diversity. Shared/private masks assign fixed routing constraints during each trajectory’s prefix, enabling diversification from one problem prompt without user-assigned roles, prescribed methods, or parameter updates.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体条件路由。 我们提出了一种免训练的推理机制，将专家可用性作为推理多样性的控制手段。 共享/私有掩码在每条轨迹的前缀阶段分配固定的路由约束，从而无需用户指定角色、规定方法或更新参数，即可从单一问题提示中实现多样化。

paragraphs.en: A multi-mode reasoning benchmark for diversity. We construct a 126-question benchmark spanning 12 mathematics and physics categories and supporting multiple solution modes. The evaluation measures how often four trajectories yield at least two distinct primary methods among soft-correct solutions. Full-benchmark evaluations by two model judges are complemented by a blinded four-expert audit on a stratified 30-problem subset across three seeds. Correctness and mean UCM@4 accompany threshold counts.
paragraphs.zh: 一个面向多样性的多模式推理基准。 我们构建了一个包含 126 个问题、覆盖 12 个数学与物理类别、并支持多种求解模式的基准。 该评估衡量四条轨迹在软正确解中产生至少两种不同主要方法的频率。 由两个模型裁判进行的全基准评估，辅以在三个种子下、对分层抽取的 30 题子集开展的盲评四专家审计。 正确率与平均 UCM@4 与阈值计数一同呈现。

paragraphs.en: ACR connects inference-time reasoning diversity with sparse-MoE conditional computation, seeking distinct primary solution methods across independent trajectories within one frozen model without specifying methods in the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: ACR 将推理时的推理多样性与稀疏 MoE 条件计算联系起来，旨在同一个冻结模型内的独立轨迹之间寻求不同的主要解题方法，而无需在提示词中指定方法。

paragraphs.en: Chain-of-thought prompting elicits intermediate reasoning, and self-consistency samples reasoning chains before aggregating their answers ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . Tree search, self-refinement, and test-time compute scaling use additional inference to improve reasoning ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Snell et al., 2025 ) . These approaches motivate generating and evaluating alternatives, but answer-level success does not establish that the alternatives execute different methods.
paragraphs.zh: 思维链提示可引出中间推理过程，而自洽性方法则先对多条推理链进行采样，再聚合它们的答案（Wei et al., 2022；Wang et al., 2023）。 树搜索、自我精炼和测试时计算扩展通过额外的推断来改进推理（Yao et al., 2023；Madaan et al., 2023；Snell et al., 2025）。 这些方法启发了对备选方案的生成与评估，但答案层面的成功并不能证明这些备选方案执行了不同的方法。

paragraphs.en: Other approaches target variation more directly. Diverse beam search separates decoded outputs ( Vijayakumar et al., 2018 ) , while diverse prompting and Flow of Reasoning target reasoning-path diversity ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . STaR develops reasoning ability through training on generated rationales ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) . ACR introduces a different control: it holds the prompt, weights, and decoding rule fixed while varying expert eligibility across trajectories. We evaluate primary executed methods among correct trajectories rather than lexical variation or answer votes.
paragraphs.zh: 其他方法更直接地针对多样性。 多样化束搜索对解码输出进行分离（Vijayakumar et al., 2018），而多样化提示与推理流则针对推理路径的多样性（Lee et al., 2024；Yu et al., 2025）。 STaR 通过在生成的推理依据上进行训练来发展推理能力（Zelikman et al., 2022）。 ACR 引入了一种不同的控制方式：它在保持提示、权重和解码规则不变的情况下，让不同轨迹的专家资格有所变化。 我们在正确轨迹中评估主要执行的方法，而不是评估词汇多样性或答案投票。

paragraphs.en: Parallel-agent systems obtain complementary outputs through multiple reasoning processes and mechanisms for combining them. Mixture-of-Agents and Sparse Mixture-of-Agents combine outputs across model agents ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ) ; multiagent debate exchanges critiques between models ( Du et al., 2024 ) . Group Think and Hogwild! Inference share partial state among concurrent workers ( Hsu et al., 2025 ; Rodionov et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: ACR instead places trajectory identity in routing constraints: trajectories share one frozen backbone but generate independently, so differentiation does not require separate weights, role prompts, or inter-agent communication.
paragraphs.zh: ACR 反而将轨迹同一性置于路由约束之中：各轨迹共享同一个冻结的主干网络，但彼此独立生成，因此差异化不需要单独的权重、角色提示或智能体间通信。

paragraphs.en: MoE research offers several ways to organize and select conditional computation, including BASE layers, expert-choice routing, ST-MoE, Mixtral, and DeepSeekMoE ( Lewis et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Zoph et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2024 ) . Related interventions contrast selected and unselected experts in SCMoE ( Shi et al., 2024 ) , learn router parameters in HyperRouter ( Do et al., 2023 ) , or learn adapter experts and a router in Self-MoE ( Kang et al., 2025 ) . Semantic routing probes further motivate expert selection as an intervention point ( Olson et al., 2025 ) . Recent work finds a domain-invariant “Standing Committee” of heavily reused experts, questioning clean domain specialization and motivating shared capacity ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ; our random shared set does not identify that committee.
paragraphs.zh: MoE 研究提供了多种组织和选择条件计算的方式，包括 BASE 层、专家选择路由、ST-MoE、Mixtral 和 DeepSeekMoE ( Lewis et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Zoph et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2024 ) 。 相关的干预工作在 SCMoE 中对比被选中和未被选中的专家 ( Shi et al., 2024 ) ，在 HyperRouter 中学习路由器参数 ( Do et al., 2023 ) ，或在 Self-MoE 中学习适配器专家和路由器 ( Kang et al., 2025 ) 。 语义路由探测进一步表明专家选择是一个合理的干预点 ( Olson et al., 2025 ) 。 近期工作发现了一个由被大量复用的专家组成的领域不变“常设委员会”，质疑了干净的领域专门化并激发了共享容量的动机 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ；我们的随机共享集合并未识别出该委员会。

paragraphs.en: The closest inference-time comparisons are RoE and Expert-Sample. RoE resamples noisy expert routes at each token and aggregates the resulting proposals into a prediction ( Zibakhsh et al., 2025 ) . Expert-Sample retains the router’s certain selections and Gumbel-resamples its uncertain tail, seeking generation diversity while preserving answer-level performance ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Both provide training-free ways to vary the computation of a frozen MoE, and we evaluate them as routing-noise controls.

paragraphs.en: The main experiments use a frozen BF16 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B checkpoint, a 35B-parameter sparse MoE with roughly 3B active parameters per token ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . We use a synthetic 11-problem development set of mathematics and physics derivations with verifiable answers and plausibly multiple methods for configuration selection. We report these development probes separately from the main evaluation, which uses a screened benchmark drawn from a hand-authored 200-problem, 12-category candidate pool spanning integrals, series, products, combinatorial identities, probability, functional equations, number theory, inequalities, mechanics, E&M, thermodynamics, and quantum physics. Each problem was screened using six temperature samples and retained only if the outputs showed multiple solution paths and at least one correct solution; 126 problems passed. The result is a diagnostic set conditioned on evidence of multiple solution paths in temperature-generated outputs. Our conclusions concern this selected population; broader task coverage is discussed in Section 5.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 主实验使用冻结的 BF16 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 检查点，这是一个 35B 参数的稀疏 MoE 模型，每个 token 约有 3B 激活参数（Qwen Team, 2026）。 我们使用一个合成的 11 题开发集，内容为数学与物理推导，答案可验证且可能存在多种解法，用于配置选择。 我们将这些开发探测与主评估分开报告；主评估使用经过筛选的基准，该基准取自一个人工编写的 200 题、12 类别的候选题池，涵盖积分、级数、乘积、组合恒等式、概率、函数方程、数论、不等式、力学、电磁学、热力学和量子物理。 每道题均通过六个温度采样进行筛选，只有当输出显示出多种解题路径且至少有一个正确解时才被保留；共有 126 道题通过筛选。 最终得到的诊断集以温度生成输出中存在多种解题路径的证据为筛选条件。 我们的结论针对这一选定总体；更广泛的任务覆盖范围将在 5.5 节中讨论。

paragraphs.en: All methods in the main benchmark use the same output budget: four generations per problem and at most 4,096 new tokens each. This matches trajectory count and output caps, not total compute or input-token usage. ACR uses deterministic decoding and one persistent mask per trajectory, sweeping P ∈ { 96,160,192 } P\in\{96,160,192\} at benchmark scale, with a repetition penalty of 1.05 and thinking disabled. The baseline draws four i.i.d. temperature samples from the unpatched model ( T ∈ { 0.5 , 0.9 , 1.1 } T\in\{0.5,0.9,1.1\} at benchmark scale and on the development sweep). The Expert-Sample baseline applies routing noise ( Chen et al., 2026 ) at benchmark scale: at every token and MoE layer, the top k keep = 5 k_{\mathrm{keep}}=5 experts by gating logit are retained, the remaining three of the k = 8 k=8 selections are Gumbel-sampled from candidate ranks 6 6 – 32 32 at τ = 1.0 \tau{=}1.0 , and weights are renormalized from the original global softmax, following the published defaults for this backbone class. The RoE baseline applies routing noise ( Zibakhsh et al., 2025 ) at benchmark scale: at every generated token the selection becomes TopK ⁡ ( R + τ ​ G , k ) \operatorname{TopK}(R+\tau G,k) with G G i.i.d. standard Gumbel on the middle MoE layers (the first and last two layers stay clean), and N = 8 N{=}8 perturbed proposals per token run in one batched forward pass whose next-token distributions are probability-averaged into a single greedy prediction, with only the clean path’s KV cache retained. The proposal count and the fixed τ = 0.5 \tau{=}0.5 are compute-driven deviations from the published per-model-tuned settings ( N = 32 / 64 N{=}32/64 ); decoding is greedy and otherwise identical to ACR . We also compare against informed sequential diversity prompting, where calls 2–4 repeat the problem with excerpts of all prior solutions and an instruction to use a fundamentally different method. It uses the same four-call budget, but later calls receive inter-attempt information and an explicit method hint, and the sequential dependency precludes batching (Table 1 , sequential arm). All other methods share one neutral problem prompt with no method hints. The held-out saturation probe draws up to 50 temperature samples to test whether a solution path merely has low sampling probability.

sents.zh: Expert-Sample 基线在基准测试规模下应用路由噪声（Chen et al., 2026）：在每个 token 和每个 MoE 层，按门控 logit 保留排名前 k keep = 5 k_{\mathrm{keep}}=5 的专家，其余三个从 k = 8 k=8 次选择中在候选排名 6 6 – 32 32 之间以 τ = 1.0 \tau{=}1.0 进行 Gumbel 采样，并基于原始全局 softmax 重新归一化权重，遵循该骨干类别已发布的默认设置。

paragraphs.en: Showing each later call prior solutions and requesting a different method yields the highest GLM diversity (Table 3 ) and finds routes absent from every blind arm. paragraphs.en: We fix eligibility at 184 experts per trajectory and layer, matching P = 160 P=160 , and retain the same handoff and generation settings. Token-resampled ACR redraws the shared/private assignment at each decoding step during the routed prefix, isolating persistence. Independent-persistent masks sample 184 experts per trajectory and layer without a common core or disjoint private sets. This tests the shared/private construction as a whole, including its effect on overlap between trajectories.

paragraphs.en: Expert eligibility provides an inference-time control for reasoning diversity within one frozen MoE, without user-assigned roles or prescribed methods. At matched output budgets, ACR yields at least two correct primary methods on approximately twice as many problems as the strongest temperature setting under GLM and 1.67 times as many under GPT-5.6 Sol. A blinded four-expert audit supports the direction of these gains on both backbones, with lower correctness for ACR. The matched-eligibility controls retain much of the diversification effect, with modest advantages for the full construction. Informed sequential prompting achieves greater diversity using previous attempts; ACR explores alternatives independently in one batched request.
paragraphs.zh: 专家资格机制在同一个冻结的 MoE 中为推理多样性提供了推理时控制，无需用户分配角色或规定方法。 在相同输出预算下，ACR 在约两倍于 GLM 下最强温度设置的问题上产生至少两种正确的主要方法，在 GPT-5.6 Sol 下约为 1.67 倍。 一项针对四名专家的盲法审计在两个骨干模型上都支持这些提升的方向，尽管 ACR 的正确性较低。 匹配资格的对照设置保留了许多多样化效果，而完整构造仅具有适度优势。 基于先前尝试的知情式顺序提示能实现更大的多样性；ACR 则在单个批量请求中独立探索备选方案。

paragraphs.en: Earlier runs retain the decoded prefix length in characters but do not store token counts or switch flags. Since decoding removes special tokens and retokenization can change token boundaries, these are estimates of cap attainment, not exact switch counts. Table 11 uses at least 1,995 retokenized tokens as the near-cap criterion.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的运行保留了以字符数表示的已解码前缀长度，但没有存储词元数量或切换标志。 我们通过在该字符偏移处切分原始文本来恢复每个前缀，并用生成模型的分词器对其进行重新分词，且不添加特殊词元。 由于解码会移除特殊词元，而重新分词可能改变词元边界，因此这些是对接近上限程度的估计值，而非精确的切换次数。 表 11 以至少 1,995 个重新分词后的词元作为接近上限的标准。

paragraphs.en: Of the 80 trajectories, 52 reach EOS before or at the prefix boundary, while 28 remain unfinished on 10 of the 20 problems. Among these 28 paired continuations, 22 reach EOS with the switch versus 14 without it. The repetition heuristic flags three full trajectories in the switch condition and four in the no-switch condition. These diagnostics distinguish termination and repetition from mathematical correctness: a trajectory may reach a correct answer before exhausting its token budget without emitting EOS. The observed gain is therefore eight additional EOS completions and one additional soft-correct trajectory, with equal aggregate diversity metrics. This subset supports a completion benefit; it does not establish that unrestricted routing is universally necessary for correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 在80条轨迹中，52条在前缀边界之前或边界处达到EOS，而28条在20个问题中的10个问题上仍未完成。 在这28组成对的续写中，使用切换时有22条达到EOS，而不使用切换时为14条。 重复启发式在切换条件下标记了3条完整轨迹，在无切换条件下标记了4条。 这些诊断将终止与重复问题同数学正确性区分开来：一条轨迹可能在耗尽其token预算之前就已得出正确答案，只是未发出EOS。 因此，观察到的收益是额外8次EOS完成和额外1条软正确轨迹，而聚合多样性指标保持相同。 这一子集支持了完成方面的收益；它并不能证明无限制的路由对正确性而言是普遍必需的。

sents.en: Of the 80 trajectories, 52 reach EOS before or at the prefix boundary, while 28 remain unfinished on 10 of the 20 problems.
sents.zh: 在80条轨迹中，52条在前缀边界之前或边界处达到EOS，而28条在20个问题中的10个问题上仍未完成。

sents.en: Among these 28 paired continuations, 22 reach EOS with the switch versus 14 without it.
sents.zh: 在这28组成对的续写中，使用切换时有22条达到EOS，而不使用切换时为14条。

sents.en: The repetition heuristic flags three full trajectories in the switch condition and four in the no-switch condition.
sents.zh: 重复启发式在切换条件下标记了3条完整轨迹，在无切换条件下标记了4条。

sents.en: These diagnostics distinguish termination and repetition from mathematical correctness: a trajectory may reach a correct answer before exhausting its token budget without emitting EOS.
sents.zh: 这些诊断将终止与重复问题同数学正确性区分开来：一条轨迹可能在耗尽其token预算之前就已得出正确答案，只是未发出EOS。

sents.en: The observed gain is therefore eight additional EOS completions and one additional soft-correct trajectory, with equal aggregate diversity metrics.
sents.zh: 因此，观察到的收益是额外8次EOS完成和额外1条软正确轨迹，而聚合多样性指标保持相同。

sents.en: This subset supports a completion benefit; it does not establish that unrestricted routing is universally necessary for correctness.
sents.zh: 这一子集支持了完成方面的收益；它并不能证明无限制的路由对正确性而言是普遍必需的。
